notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9940578/4501a6bb9346dda61112b5511f3f75b48df3c73e.png

Merry Christmas to all Wild Animal fans from Ginger the Giraffe, Hugo the hippo and all the Wild Animal crew.

Hope everyone's having a nice time and not too cold 🥶🥶⛄☃ (or hot... 🥵 depending on where you live.. 🦘)

Don't forget it is the Steam Winter Sale so you can find lots of bargains this winter. (Which is actually summer if you live in the Southern Hemisphere. Which is a "fun" fact.)  

Some of you may not know that there is more than one Wild Animal game:


 Wild Animal Racing (where it all started...)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/389510/Wild_Animal_Racing


 Wild Animal Sports Day (it continues...)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/741990/Wild_Animal_Sports_Day


 The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe (a spinoff for Ginger in this spin-off game)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1033220/The_Amazing_Shrinking_Giraffe/

And coming soon (6 Jan 2023)....

 Puzzling Wild IQ Test - (a different kind of game to test how big your brain is)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078070/Puzzling_Wild_IQ_Test/


Or if you like text adventures (which is not part of the Wild Animal series) there is also:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781920/The_Haunted_House_of_Doom/


Hope you all have a fantastic new year and wishing you all have an interesting and exciting 2023.

As for me my new year's resolution is to finish painting my room and make more games. Shouldn't be too difficult. What's yours?

Paul.

notes.title: Coming Soon: Puzzling Wild IQ Test
notes.content:
Do you like to test your brain? 

Out by end of year (2022):

Puzzling Wild IQ Test

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078070/Puzzling_Wild_IQ_Test/

Your favourite characters Ginger T Giraffe, and Hugo T Hippo, present 400 logic puzzles to test how clever you are. Each puzzle has no instructions, you just use your logic and reasoning to paint in the answer. The game collects everyone's score and uses it to estimate your IQ using math™. 

Add it to your wish list if it's your sort of thing.

More info to come shortly...

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2078070/ss_30535a50a5e1815419814de6a6b9bf04bbd73081.600x338.jpg?t=1670060459

notes.title: A Wild Halloween game...???!!
notes.content:
From the creator of Wild Animal Racing, a new 2D command driven adventure game. You have to go round the different rooms and collect the items to solve the mystery. But beware... some surprises await! If you are easily scared, maybe best to avoid this one!

If not, have a go. Can you solve the mystery of The Haunted House of Doom?

Get them both now or if you own one of these games you can get the bundle deal to get the other at a discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16584/Wild_Animal_Racing__Haunted_House_of_Doom_Halloween_Bundle/

notes.title: Online multiplayer update
notes.content:
Update (18 April): I am creating a new server. Should be up and running in the next couple of days.

Technical stuff below...

In the forthcoming update, I've made some changes to the online multiplayer mode as it was not working for some people. I've disabled the "facilitator" as a default which was causing problems which just means that it should work if you have a direct connection to the internet. 

Also, I've added some instructions if anyone wants to attempt to set up their own server. (This is mainly for experts!) There is an instruction file if you go to the "browse local files" in Steam. 

I have made these changes to the Windows files. If everything is fine I'll then update the Mac files.

Let me know if this works or doesn't for you. :spelunky:
